purchases.title: My Full Travel List for Exploring Latin America:
purchases.summary:
My Full Travel List for Exploring Latin America:

## Documents
-  Passport (with 12+ months of validity).
-  2 printed passport copies (in case you lose the original).
- Bank statement with +$3,500 balance (in case they ask for it at a border control)
- Prepare real or fake return/exit flight tickets for countries where you plan yo enter. If you don't have such a return/exit ticket, they might not let you enter a country or board a plane to a country. So best is to either buy a return ticket or if you don't know when you would return, create a fake return ticket with Canva. Just take a real PD
